name: PANORÁMA TRAIL
description: The Panoráma Trail is a unique trail-running marathon in the Zemplén Mountains, linking the historic castles of Boldogkő, Regéc and Füzér. The 45-kilometre route follows varied, technical forest trails, where nature and history meet. The race is not about finishing times, but about the experience and challenge, and can be completed individually or as part of a three-person team. With premium organisation and an environmentally conscious approach, the event welcomes runners in October, when conditions are ideal for running.

Varied, technical terrain with rocky trails and stream crossings
Several aid stations at Mogyoróska, Regéc, Telkibánya and Hollóháza

The race follows panoramic routes through the hills of Somogy, around Csillagó Hill, with a range of distances, including a half marathon and a pairs relay. Participants can run among beautiful autumn vineyards, forests, and historic sites, with a unique finisher’s medal and gifts awaiting them at the finish. Trail running and hiking, wines, cooking in a cauldron, a family-friendly atmosphere, and autumn views of Lake Balaton.

name: JAZZFŐVÁROS-FUTÁS
description: The Jazz Capital Run takes place in Kecskemét at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre, offering a running experience as a sporting complement to the jazz festival. Traditionally, the event puts the joy of running and the sense of community first, and is open to all ages and types of runners. It is not only a sporting event but also strengthens the local community, while participants can enjoy exercising in beautiful surroundings and fresh air. The organisers also value charity, so the run is an opportunity to support a cause.

name: SZUFLA FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: The SZUFLA Running Festival is a traditional community running event organized by the Enthusiastic Team of Szigethalom Ultrarunners every second weekend in August. The 2026 event, the 20th anniversary festival, will take place in Tököl Park Forest and features a variety of distances, including an ultramarathon, relay, half marathon, shorter races, and hiking. The event has a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere, with plenty of activities for children as well as runners. Its aim is to promote sport and support the local community, with particular emphasis on helping people with disabilities.

Aid stations every 3 km with a generous selection of refreshments

description: The dm Balaton RUN will take place in Zamárdi on September 19, 2026, offering runners the chance to run along one of the most beautiful stretches of the Balaton shoreline. The race is family-friendly and suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, with several distances: 2.3 km, 5.25 km, 10.5 km, half marathon, and half-marathon relay. The race pack includes a premium Mizuno T-shirt, a custom-designed finisher’s medal awaits participants at the finish, and environmentally friendly, cup-free refreshments are provided. The route runs mostly along the lakeshore, allowing participants to enjoy the atmosphere of the Balaton and the early autumn sunshine.

Panoramic views of Tihany on the opposite shore
Environmentally friendly, cup-free refreshment stations along the course

It is organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association, which supports running and orienteering through several departments. Runners can test their strength on varied terrain in a natural setting while enjoying the scenic landscapes of Bakonyalja. The event has a friendly atmosphere and is open to all age groups.

Varied trail-running routes
Scenic Bakonyalja landscape

description: DOMB42X is a unique running race at Kecskemét’s highest point, Benkó Hill, where participants run up and down the nearly 50-metre-high hill several times. One lap of the course is 1.0047 km, and runners complete between 3 and 42 laps, depending on the distance, making the event span from half-marathon to ultramarathon. The race is distinguished by its substantial elevation gain, which exceeds 2,000 metres over the marathon distance. The event is family-friendly: entry is free for spectators, and the recreation park offers them a variety of activities and sports facilities.
course_highlights: Repeated ascents and descents of nearly 50-metre-high Benkó Hill
One lap is 1.0047 km, with substantial elevation gain
More than 2,000 metres of elevation gain over the marathon distance
additional: A display shows the number of completed laps after each lap, so runners do not have to keep count in their heads. The event is family-friendly, with free entry for spectators. The recreation park has a playground, beach volleyball, beach football, a basketball court, hiking trails, lakes, fishing facilities, a snack bar and a restaurant. The different distances have age limits and participant caps, and prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in each gender category. Trail running, multiple distances, family-friendly activities, a commitment to sustainability, children’s races, elevation gain, multi-lap courses

The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and also serves as a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program, allowing participants to earn points and rewards. The event’s patrons include the mayor of Esztergom and well-known athletes, adding to its prestige.

description: The BMW BERLIN-MARATHON is one of the world’s largest and most popular marathons, taking place in Berlin on September 27, 2026. The race is famous for its record-breaking, exceptionally flat course, which passes many of the city’s most beautiful landmarks. Thanks to its diversity and the city’s unique energy, the event offers a special experience not only for professional runners but also for running enthusiasts. The race is part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors series, and participants can choose from a range of options, including charity running, inline skating, and the Generali 5K.
course_highlights: One of the flattest marathon courses in the world, with minimal elevation gain
The course passes many of Berlin’s most beautiful landmarks, including the Brandenburg Gate
15 refreshment stations along the course, as well as BRITA water refill stations
additional: On race day, clothing and valuables cannot be checked in at the start area, but every finisher receives a warm, reusable poncho free of charge at the finish. Clothing check can be booked for €5, but in that case no poncho is provided. Race packets can only be collected in person at the MARATHON EXPO, with photo ID and a start card. Participants receive a 4-day public transport ticket for the duration of the event. Runners can also place their own refreshments on the course with advance registration and labeling. The Generali 5K starts on September 26 at 10:00. The start is at Potsdamer Platz, and the finish is on Straße des 17. Juni, beyond the Brandenburg Gate. Inline skating, a 5 km run, and charity options are also available at the event. Details about registration, race day, and fundraising options can be found on the official website.

Many runners choose the half marathon as their first, as the course and its spectacular sections make for an unforgettable experience. The event is family-friendly, with a Baby Run for the youngest participants. Runners in every distance receive a finisher’s medal, refreshments and a running T-shirt.
